status: public redacted edition; architecture approved with feasibility gates

evidence_level.READ: code and tests read, not executed
evidence_level.RECORDED: recorded in a repository file about the host, not re-observed
evidence_level.UNKNOWN: cannot be established from the repositories

gaps.title: Authentication hook receives method, path and headers but not the request body
gaps.workaround: Carry the device-signed envelope inside function arguments and verify it in the handler
gaps.work_to_close: Add body-digest verification or pass a verified content digest to the hook

gaps.title: Change stream is invalidation-only with no cursor or resume
gaps.workaround: Agents poll a versioned netmap; events are a latency hint only
gaps.work_to_close: Data-carrying, filtered, resumable subscription for non-browser clients

gaps.title: Function HTTP API has no formal wire specification and only a JS client
gaps.workaround: Use the AppPort request wire, which is documented and language-neutral
gaps.work_to_close: Publish and version the function API contract

gaps.title: No cron; recurring schedules are interval-only and no test shows one firing
gaps.workaround: Use the in-process job worker with self-rescheduling jobs
gaps.work_to_close: Test schedule firing; add cron if needed

gaps.title: Mutation audit is durable but explicitly not tamper-evident
gaps.workaround: Accept as stated residual risk; export audit off-host
gaps.work_to_close: Hash-chain or sign audit records

gaps.title: Single stateful process with an exclusive lock; no high availability or multi-process live updates
gaps.workaround: Accept: agents keep working when the control plane is down
gaps.work_to_close: Multi-instance support

gaps.title: FeltDB change events carry no record values and cannot be filtered per collection or device
gaps.workaround: Not used directly; the mesh reads through FeltKit
gaps.work_to_close: Payload-carrying filtered change feed

gaps.title: Power-loss durability explicitly not established; history held in memory without bound
gaps.workaround: Hourly backup bundle; agents hold last applied state; control state is reconstructible from agent reports only in part
gaps.work_to_close: Establish and test crash durability; bound in-memory history

gaps.title: Per-request audit log is unchained and a lost event does not fail the request
gaps.workaround: Rely on FeltKit's atomic per-mutation audit instead
gaps.work_to_close: Make audit loss fail the request; add sequence and chain

gaps.title: No device or machine principal, proof-of-possession, enrollment tokens or user-to-device ownership
gaps.workaround: Device identity, signing and enrollment live in the mesh application
gaps.work_to_close: Device principal with registered public key, signed-request verification, enrollment tokens, key rotation

gaps.title: Agent credential families end after at most 30 days and then need a human
gaps.workaround: Not used for device identity
gaps.work_to_close: Policy-renewable machine identity

gaps.title: No Rust or other non-JS client; no offline-verifiable tokens (no JWT, JWKS or signing keys)
gaps.workaround: Only the control app calls AuthBoundry, from TypeScript
gaps.work_to_close: Rust client; signed assertions or a revocation feed

gaps.title: Events are at-most-once with no buffering or replay; core stores are memory-only
gaps.workaround: Events not used for correctness
gaps.work_to_close: Durable event cursor; durable stores

gaps.title: Webhook destination policy blocks private ranges and 100.64.0.0/10, so webhooks to mesh addresses are refused
gaps.workaround: None needed for the MVP
gaps.work_to_close: Allow explicitly authorized mesh destinations

gaps.title: No manifest schema for network requirements; only 'none' and 'egress'
gaps.workaround: None; out of MVP scope
gaps.work_to_close: Network requirement schema and deployment-intent policy

gaps.title: All app containers share one bridge; no per-app network identity, no egress rules, no network-isolation tests
gaps.workaround: None; out of MVP scope
gaps.work_to_close: Per-app network or fixed address; enforcement backend; isolation tests

gaps.title: Host agent never passes FeltDB connection settings to app containers, so no app-to-FeltDB network path exists
gaps.workaround: None; out of MVP scope
gaps.work_to_close: Wire managed FeltDB into agent-deployed apps

gaps.title: Platform services publish on loopback only; nothing binds to a mesh address
gaps.workaround: MVP proves access with one chosen service
gaps.work_to_close: Additional port bindings on the mesh address per service

gaps.title: A UDP port must be opened on the host firewall, and every installer is written never to touch the firewall
gaps.workaround: None
gaps.work_to_close: One separately approved ufw UDP allow rule

gaps.title: Host facts unknown: WireGuard module and tools, UDP listeners, IPv6 addressing, forwarding settings, raw packet-filter rules, provider-side firewall
gaps.workaround: None
gaps.work_to_close: Run scripts/host-preflight.sh (read-only)

gaps.title: Host backup, off-host copy, metrics and alerting posture is unverified
gaps.workaround: None
gaps.work_to_close: Verify backups run; add an off-host copy and a restore test for mesh control data

gaps.title: Restarting the container runtime would disrupt co-located workloads
gaps.workaround: Agent never restarts Docker and owns its own nftables table
gaps.work_to_close: None required; treat as a standing constraint

gaps.title: Repository documents conflict on which platform services run on the host
gaps.workaround: None
gaps.work_to_close: Observe the host; correct the stale document

gaps.title: Only one always-on machine is under Boundry's control; the hub is a single point of failure
gaps.workaround: Accept for the MVP
gaps.work_to_close: A second always-on member; later a second hub

gaps.title: Resolver has no DNS protocol, address record types or device lifecycle binding
gaps.workaround: Mesh Control owns names; agents answer DNS
gaps.work_to_close: None; different problem domain. Optionally publish service aliases as endpoint refs

gaps.title: Node agent, control application, agent protocol, operator signer and deployment package do not exist
gaps.workaround: None
gaps.work_to_close: Milestones M1 to M6

gaps.title: Which userspace WireGuard implementation defguard_wireguard_rs drives on macOS is unverified
gaps.workaround: Fallback: netlink crate on Linux plus the userspace control socket on macOS, or a Go agent
gaps.work_to_close: Spike on Linux and macOS

gaps.title: AuthBoundry integration is tested mainly against fakes; AppPort Services ships no AuthBoundry client
gaps.workaround: MVP uses FeltKit roles for operator authorization
gaps.work_to_close: Integration tests against a real AuthBoundry server

gaps.title: No CI infrastructure for real-network tests; WireGuard on GitHub-hosted runners unverified
gaps.evidence: No self-hosted runner label in any workflow
gaps.workaround: Network namespaces on hosted runners if the module loads; otherwise virtual machines
gaps.work_to_close: Establish the lab harness

note: Entries held privately are omitted, so ids are not contiguous. Host-specific detail is held in the private host baseline.
